links.outcome: Implicit bias magnitude across demographic categories in LLMs (IAT-style bias score)
links.effect: All 10 models exhibited systematic implicit biases (Mean IAT Bias > 0) across all categories; strongest in Race (Mean = 0.61) and Socioeconomic Status (Mean = 0.56).
links.quote: All 10 models exhibited systematic implicit biases (Mean IAT Bias > 0) across all categories, with the strongest biases observed in Race (Mean = 0.61) and Socioeconomic Status (Mean = 0.56).
